class.name: GDCubismMotionLoader
class.brief_description: Legacy motion JSON to Animation resource loader.
class.description: Retained upstream converter for [code].motion3.json[/code] resources. It approximates Bezier handle times, uses infinity for stepped handles, adds an inverse-step key offset and skips non-parameter curves. Do not treat its output as lossless native Cubism playback or as a hardened import validator. Full conversion/hardening is deferred P1 work. Use [CubismModelImporter] with [CubismModel2D] for the supported native-motion path; [member CubismMotionDescriptor.animation] is not required for that path.
